NOT JOINED:
154:26 itself — its `border-color` is the DRAWER's edge, not the panel's:
`.ls-panel` paints `border-right: 1px solid var(--bk-border)` and the DS
panel inside it has no border of its own. Giving it one would draw a second
hairline on three sides to make a number match. Same call, same reason, as
surfaces/components-library.json.
1691:7341, the preview band — `height: 82px` is a Figma text-metric artifact.
The band is `overflow-clip` at a fixed 82 over three children whose own
frame heights are 20 / 11 / 11; an 11px-tall row of 15px type does not exist
in CSS, and reproducing 82 in the browser means clipping the specimens by 8.
Its gap and its 16/12 inset ARE conformed, and its gap is measured through
1691:7342 and the two specimen rows.
1691:7343..7346, the four swatches — their fills are the demo project's own
palette (#1A56DB / #F8FAFC / #334155 / #EF4444 against the board's #1a56db /
#ffffff / #1f2937 / #ef4444). That is sample data by the founder's rule, and
every one of the four carries `background-color` since the 2026-09-08
extractor change, so there is no fill-free swatch left to join. Their border
and radius are conformed in code regardless.
